title: Update tooltips to reflect Microsoft Entra terminology in Fabric setup pages
summary: Tooltips on the Fabric Platform Setup page and the Fabric Platform Setup Wizard page now use Microsoft Entra terminology. The Fabric Platform Credential Mgt codeunit also received a small related change.
key_points: Tooltips on the Fabric Platform Setup and Setup Wizard pages reworded to use Microsoft Entra terminology
Small related edit in the Fabric Platform Credential Mgt codeunit
